protocol: Fixed inference threshold; class-aware confidence-greedy one-to-one matching, IoU >= 0.50
size_definition: GT area after scaling longest image side to 640: small <= 32^2 pixels
density_definition: dense = >=10 annotated targets per image; not an occlusion label
test_history: Existing test set was already used for standard AP reporting; no retraining or threshold tuning on test

config.selection: max no_helmet F1 on 0.10..0.80 step 0.05; ties: precision then threshold

ordinary_hat_qualitative.note: Excluded image; visual qualitative check only; incomplete original labels not scored

hardware_supplement.note: Unified memory recorded at closeout; formal training batch=8.

demo.preparation: Crop original frames: x=400,y=350,width=1050,height=650; encode H.264 at 24 fps; discard audio. No model/threshold changes.
demo.independence_limit: Downloaded separately after model training; no identified similarity in 15 sampled original frames versus 7035 raw images. This does not prove all scene ancestry is disjoint.
demo.interpretation: Unlabelled qualitative demonstration only. Frame counts of detector output are not accuracy or unique-person counts. Full uncropped frame at index 220 missed the bare head; cropped view recovered it.

checks.camera: Optional, not tested; no camera opened
